title: Paow · vila (kort text): ler
summary: Gör en vilofilm av Paow: hon sitter still, och filmen börjar och slutar på ankare 1.

step.label: Vila, samma bild först och sist

reference.why: WAN 3 tar ingen referensfilm tillsammans med första och sista bild.

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. She starts and ends exactly as in the first frame, and holds still for the last half second. About one second in her eyes rest on the camera and her soft smile grows into a warm, friendly smile with closed lips that reaches her eyes, holds for a moment, and relaxes back to the calm expression of the first image. From the third second she is in the first pose and holds still to the end.
